entities.summary: Philip Morris Glass is an American composer and pianist. He is widely regarded as one of the most influential composers of the late 20th century. Glass' work has been associated with minimalism, being built up from repetitive phrases and shifting layers. He described himself as a composer of "music with repetitive structures", which he has helped to evolve stylistically. Philip Glass was a composers & musicians from Baltimore (b. 1937-01-31, Baltimore). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
